gear_priority.current_build: Advanced SS DPS build. Weapon, necklace, and gloves are already high-forged. Chest, belt, and boots appear lower-forged.
gear_priority.selector_rule: Open selectors only when the forge screen shows the exact missing type. Do not pre-open all selectors.

quick_answer: Spend tech core choice chests into Soccer Mode first. Then push SS Belt forge using exact selectors only if needed. After that, spend awakening crystals only if Nutjob/Xeno reaches the next star now. Save S-grade packs unless they finish that SS forge step.

direct_spend_plan.title: Spend tech core choice chests into Soccer Mode first
direct_spend_plan.target: Soccer Mode / Soccer Twinborn resonance until the next cheap breakpoint, then rerun SIO.
direct_spend_plan.why: Your tech resonance is uneven and Soccer Mode is one of the lowest at 550. Your SIO comparison showed Soccer as the visible positive swap (+3.82%), so this is the cleanest spend that does not burn relic/core selectors.
direct_spend_plan.stop_condition: After each breakpoint, rerun/reload SIO. If Soccer stops being positive, stop and move remaining tech cores to the next active DPS tech SIO ranks highest: Drone, Rocket, Laser, or Lightning.
direct_spend_plan.confidence: High for first spend direction; medium for exact final amount until exact breakpoint costs are added.

direct_spend_plan.title: Push SS Belt next, then SS Boots, then SS Chest
resource_to_use: core_choice_chest x6 only for exact missing core type
eternal_cores x20 / chaos_cores x10 only if exact requirement
direct_spend_plan.target: Next affordable Astral/SS forge breakpoint on SS Belt first. If not affordable, try SS Boots. If not, try SS Chest.
direct_spend_plan.why: Your weapon, necklace, and gloves already look like the high-forge damage core. Belt is the best lower-forge damage slot to push next. Chest is last because this optimizer ignores HP/survival.
direct_spend_plan.stop_condition: Do not open all selectors in advance. Open only enough to complete the shown forge step. If the step cannot be completed now, save unopened selectors.

direct_spend_plan.title: Use awakening crystals only if Nutjob/Xeno reaches next star now
direct_spend_plan.target: Nutjob/Xeno next star/stat breakpoint, not random normal pets.
direct_spend_plan.why: Your build is already Nutjob/Xeno based with 85% sync and 4-star visible awakening power. Awakening crystals are good only when they complete a real stat/star breakpoint.
direct_spend_plan.stop_condition: If 22 crystals do not unlock the next star/stat, save them. Do not spend gems on normal pet chests unless the event gives guaranteed Xeno crystals better than direct selector value.

direct_spend_plan.title: Keep S-grade packs as exact SS fodder
resource_to_use: S-grade excellent equipment choice pack x12
Voidwalker excellent equipment supply crate x1
direct_spend_plan.target: Open only the exact S equipment needed to finish SS Belt, Boots, or Chest forge/core conversion.
direct_spend_plan.why: These packs are flexible stored value. Randomly opening them before the forge screen asks for a specific piece can trap the wrong faction/piece.
direct_spend_plan.stop_condition: If no exact SS forge step is available, keep all packs closed.

direct_spend_plan.title: Spend gems only on guaranteed breakpoint materials
direct_spend_plan.target: Relic cores, tech core selectors, Xeno crystals, or guaranteed S/SS selectors. Avoid random normal pet/equipment chest spam.
direct_spend_plan.why: At your account level, random chests are normally worse than guaranteed materials that finish one of the top three plans.
direct_spend_plan.stop_condition: If the event shop cannot buy one of those materials at good value, save gems.
